1.consolidated_definition: Árbol alto y frondoso, de hojas compuestas, flores blancas y fruto capsular, en forma de vaina retorcida; su madera se emplea en carpintería. Fabaceae Pithecellobium obovale.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tall tree with compound leaves, white flowers, and a capsule-shaped fruit in the form of a twisted pod; its wood is used in carpentry. Fabaceae Pithecellobium obovale.
